research.title: Market Microstructure Research
research.description: Quantitative market microstructure methods with Python and Rust implementations.

research.title: State-Dependent Limit Order Book Dynamics
research.description: Finite-state queue-reactive continuous-time Markov models for stationary liquidity configurations, spectral relaxation, first-passage times, and finite-horizon queue-depletion probabilities. Includes reproducible analytical validation and documented numerical limitations.

research.title: Latency-Constrained Price Discovery and Formal Analysis of Executable Liquidity in Fragmented Markets
research.description: Deterministic price-time matching and cancellation analysis across independent trading venues, with explicit message transmission lifecycles, participant-specific observation constraints, and finite attainable execution sets. Includes reproducible analytical reference tests and documented limits on nonanticipativity, empirical calibration, and price-discovery interpretation.
